sources.title: Western Balkans 6: Albania Country Climate and Development Report Compendium
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate and socioeconomic data, historical hazards through 2023, municipal hazard rankings and policy review.
sources.methodology: World Bank compendium combines climate, infrastructure and socioeconomic data, scenario analysis and policy review.
sources.limitations: Municipal scores are aggregate and modeled; they are not household-level risk or conflict estimates.

sources.title: Albania's National Adaptation Plan 2026–2036
sources.organization: Government of Albania, Ministry of Environment, with UNDP and Green Climate Fund support
sources.temporal_coverage: National climate risks and an adaptation framework for 2026–2036; municipal plans developed during 2022–2024.
sources.methodology: National plan synthesizes sector and municipal climate-risk assessments and prioritizes adaptation measures.
sources.limitations: Municipal profiles summarize underlying plans; targets and risk ratings are not independent implementation evaluations.

sources.title: National Security Strategy of the Republic of Albania 2023–2028
sources.organization: Republic of Albania, Ministry of Defence
sources.temporal_coverage: National security strategy for 2023–2028; relevant climate-security passage addresses global-level risks.
sources.methodology: Official strategy assesses global, regional and national security risks and institutional responses.
sources.limitations: Climate-security passages are global risk framing, not Albania-specific empirical causal findings.

sources.title: Local Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Shkoder Municipality: Project Summary
sources.temporal_coverage: Local adaptation planning project delivered June–October 2025.
sources.methodology: One-page summary from the implementing institute reports plan outputs and partners.
sources.limitations: The summary does not include the full hazard analysis or independently evaluated adaptation results.

sources.title: ALBAdapt: Climate-Resilient Urban Development Programme
sources.organization: Republic of Albania, Ministry of Environment
sources.temporal_coverage: Programme components and expected beneficiaries reported in July 2026.
sources.methodology: Ministry programme announcement describes planned components and expected reach; text translated from Albanian.
sources.limitations: Programme intentions and beneficiary targets are not measured results.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 69, Annex C, Table C.1 and methodology note
claims.paraphrase: The CCDR's socioeconomic-vulnerability list includes Dropull, Këlcyrë, Përmet, Kolonjë, Fushë Arrës and Mallakastër among the highest-ranked municipalities.
claims.limitations: The composite vulnerability score uses population change and market access; it is not hazard exposure.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 69, Annex C, Table C.1 and flood-exposure definitions
claims.paraphrase: The CCDR's ranked high-flood-exposure list names Fier, Lushnje, Shkodër, Roskovec, Divjakë, Rrogozhinë and Vau i Dejës.
claims.limitations: High exposure means modeled average flood depth at least 0.5m for a 1% annual-probability event, not resident counts.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 14, section 2.1, urban expansion and flood exposure
claims.paraphrase: Flooding has worsened exposure for disadvantaged informal communities along riverbeds in Tirana, Durrës, Vlora, Shkodër and Lezha.
affected_groups: socially vulnerable and disadvantaged informal communities
claims.limitations: The report names municipal areas but provides no affected-household totals in this passage.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 21, social-protection climate-shock assessment
claims.paraphrase: The CCDR says low coverage and benefit adequacy limit climate-shock support; Ndihma Ekonomike systems showed flexibility during the 2019 earthquake response but cannot yet scale to additional climate-affected poor households.
claims.limitations: The flexibility example is earthquake response, not a tested climate-shock scale-up.

claims.locator: Printed pp. 68–69, section 4.4, local vulnerability profiles
claims.paraphrase: NAP profiles flag hotter, drier summers in Durrës; erosion, landslides and shortages in Elbasan; floods across Fier; and flood/intense-rain risk in Kukës.
claims.limitations: Summary diagnoses, not comparable loss counts.

claims.locator: Printed pp. 66–67, urban development section and Table 8
claims.paraphrase: Future urban risk is rated very high for Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Fier, Shkodër, Elbasan and the coastal belt across four subsectors.
claims.scenario: Best- and worst-case urban scenarios; no emissions pathway specified.
claims.limitations: Risk ratings, not loss or affected-person forecasts.

claims.paraphrase: Marginalized riverbank neighborhoods face heat and heavy-rain risk; women are more vulnerable. Without climate-linked social protection, risks may trigger community tipping points.

claims.locator: Printed p. 72, section 5.2, Local Adaptation Plans
claims.paraphrase: The NAP reports eight municipal plans developed with technical staff, data collection and capacity-building; each identified about 85 adaptation measures and 45 priorities on average.
claims.limitations: Plans are preparation outputs, not delivery or effectiveness.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 5, section 3.a, global-level climate-security discussion
claims.paraphrase: The strategy frames climate risks as global security concerns: warming and degradation may intensify resource rivalry, migration, uncontrolled movement and political instability.
claims.scenario: National Security Strategy horizon 2023–2028; no climate emissions pathway specified.
affected_groups: people affected by resource scarcity or displacement
claims.limitations: This is a global-level strategy statement, not evidence of local climate-caused conflict in Albania.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The strategy links warming and degradation to resource competition, migration and instability.

claims.locator: PDF printed p. 5, section 3.a, disaster and humanitarian-crisis management
claims.paraphrase: The strategy says climate change may affect the effectiveness of state and international actors managing natural disasters and humanitarian crises.
claims.scenario: National Security Strategy horizon 2023–2028; no climate emissions pathway specified.
claims.limitations: The strategy gives no Albania-specific agency, event or operational measure.

claims.locator: PDF p. 1, Results of the project
claims.paraphrase: ETMI reports Shkodër's local adaptation plan was delivered in 2025, with sector analyses, prioritized actions and a governance and monitoring framework supported by stakeholder engagement.
claims.limitations: The one-page implementer summary reports outputs, not plan implementation or risk-reduction outcomes.

claims.locator: Programme description, climate-information and services component (translated from Albanian)
claims.paraphrase: ALBAdapt plans to modernize climate and meteorological monitoring, forecasting and digital climate data to improve services for agriculture, tourism and civil protection.
claims.limitations: The ministry describes programme activities, not measured forecast or service improvements.

claims.locator: Programme description, multi-hazard early-warning component (translated from Albanian)
claims.paraphrase: The programme is establishing a people-centred multi-hazard early-warning system to improve interagency coordination; about 700,000 people are expected to benefit directly.
claims.scenario: ALBAdapt programme target; no climate scenario stated.
claims.limitations: Expected reach is a programme target; the system's coverage and effectiveness were not measured in the announcement.

claims.locator: Programme description, local coastal adaptation component (translated from Albanian)
claims.paraphrase: ALBAdapt supports planned nature-based measures, local preparedness and risk-sensitive planning in the most climate-exposed coastal areas.
claims.limitations: The announcement does not name recipient localities or report completed measures.

access_audit.locator: PDF printed pp. 14, 21 and 69; Annex C methods and Table C.1
access_audit.notes: Opened the public 90-page CCDR compendium and read the local rankings, flood-vulnerable settlements and social-protection passages.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Rights section permits noncommercial reproduction with attribution; other terms not assessed.

access_audit.locator: PDF pp. 64, 67–68, urban risk tables, local vulnerabilities and LAP process
access_audit.notes: Opened and read the 148-page English National Adaptation Plan; its UNDP page dates the portal publication January 2026 while the PDF copy itself gives no publication date.
Opened the official Albanian-language 36-page strategy and translated its global-level climate-security passage; no English-snippet claims used.

access_audit.locator: One-page project summary, Results of the project
access_audit.notes: Read the full public project summary; the detailed Shkodër Local Adaptation Plan itself was not linked in this source.

access_audit.locator: Programme description and three components, translated from Albanian
access_audit.notes: Opened and read the Ministry's public programme announcement, including climate services, expected early-warning reach and local coastal adaptation.

access_audit.locator: Official English-language National Security Strategy PDF
access_audit.notes: English file returned HTTP 502; the official Albanian-language law and strategy PDF were opened and used instead.

search_audit.query: Albania municipality flood wildfire landslide climate exposure vulnerability report local adaptation plan
search_audit.outcome: Opened the CCDR municipal hazard rankings, the 2026 NAP's eight local-plan profiles and ETMI's Shkodër plan summary; full underlying Shkodër plan was not available.

search_audit.query: Albania climate security migration resource competition displacement conflict national security strategy
search_audit.outcome: The National Security Strategy describes resource rivalry, migration and instability as global climate-security pathways; it provides no Albania-specific climate-conflict estimate or incident.

search_audit.query: Albania political violence insecurity conflict disrupting climate adaptation disaster response services report
search_audit.outcome: No country-specific source connected insecurity or conflict to disrupted climate adaptation or service delivery. The strategy says climate risks can challenge crisis-management effectiveness, which is not evidence of conflict blocking adaptation.

search_audit.query: Albania local adaptation plans disaster risk management capacity climate early warning municipal framework GCF ALBAdapt
search_audit.outcome: The NAP documents local planning capacity; ETMI reports a Shkodër plan and governance framework; the Ministry describes planned ALBAdapt climate services and warning-system reach.

gaps: No pre-existing ALB country dossier was present under countries/ in this worktree; this is new-country Phase 2 extraction.
The National Security Strategy's climate-security passage is global risk framing, not an Albania-specific causal finding; no armed-conflict or climate-related violence link was established.

The English Ministry-hosted National Security Strategy file returned HTTP 502; the official Albanian PDF was opened and translated. The full Shkodër local adaptation plan was not linked, only its project summary.
No accessible source linked conflict or insecurity to weaker climate adaptation or disaster-service delivery; this is an evidence gap, not evidence of absence.
